title: Pandya's Back Spasm Benches MI Captain Again vs RCB
excerpt: Hardik Pandya misses his second straight IPL 2026 match as Mumbai Indians face RCB in a must-win Raipur clash on May 10.
body:
Mumbai Indians captain Hardik Pandya sat out Sunday's IPL 2026 match against Royal Challengers Bengaluru in Raipur, sidelined for the second consecutive game by a recurring back spasm. Suryakumar Yadav stepped up to lead the five-time champions for the second match in a row.

**What happened:**
Mumbai Indians' medical team issued an official update confirming that Hardik Pandya would not play in today's game due to recurrent back spasms. Although the all-rounder travelled with the MI squad to Raipur ahead of the crucial fixture against RCB, the franchise management decided not to risk him without full medical clearance. Pandya had also missed the previous clash due to the same back spasms issue, and earlier in the season, he sat out the away loss against Delhi Capitals due to illness.

**Why this hurts MI:**
Pandya's absence is a tactical blow to Mumbai Indians — as a fast-bowling all-rounder, his unavailability forces MI to rely heavily on players like Corbin Bosch and Raj Bawa to fill the void in both the middle order and the bowling attack. Currently placed ninth on the table with six points from ten matches, Mumbai Indians face a virtual must-win situation, and another defeat could make them the first team eliminated from the IPL 2026 playoff race. Hardik has also struggled for consistency this season, scoring only 146 runs and taking four wickets in eight matches.

**What to watch:**
No official word has emerged on the extent of Pandya's injury or his recovery timeline, and MI still have three matches remaining in the league phase — every one of them a potential lifeline for a team fighting to survive.
